read.thesis: Chubb's property market is softening fast: shared and layered property written pricing fell 14.3% and market pricing on business passed up fell 30-40%, so Chubb is shedding large-account property while core earnings grew and tangible book value rose 16.5%.

triggers.label: Shared/layered property written pricing -14.3%
triggers.quote: Property pricing was down 14.3% in shared and layered major and specialty for the business we wrote.

triggers.label: Market property pricing down 25-30%, heading to 30%
triggers.quote: Pricing overall is off 25% in the quarter, heading to 30%. It's -- you can actually see it's accelerating in that trend.

triggers.label: Capital chasing MGA volume incentives
triggers.quote: And it's showing up a lot of it in a volume-based incentive system. MGAs. The majority of them, it's just volume based.

triggers.label: Large-account property shrunk, half of volume shed
triggers.quote: large account E&S, the property I talked about is where we're -- well, we shed half the volume.

triggers.label: NA casualty pricing +9.6%
triggers.quote: Casualty pricing in North America was up 9.6% with rates up 8.4% and exposure of 1.1%.

guidance.quote: We expect adjusted net investment income in the second quarter to be between $1.825 billion to $1.85 billion.

guidance.metric: Full-year core operating effective tax rate
guidance.quote: We continue to expect core operating effective tax rate for the full year to be in the range of 19.5% to 20%.

red_flags.label: Property pricing collapse; MGA volume-based capital
red_flags.quote: Property pricing in certain markets softened at a pace described by management as “dumb,”

red_flags.label: Loosening terms and conditions on the margin
red_flags.quote: Terms and conditions just on the margin, not 0, but on the margin.
